Workshop: Automated Collation and Alignment with CollateX

Overview: In this workshop, you will collate your primary witness transcription against a peer's witness and an authoritative base text using both manual visual inspection and the programmatic CollateX engine in Python. You will inspect the resulting variant graph, adjudicate discrepancies, and export an aligned TEI apparatus block.

Deadlines: Comparison Post due Friday by 11:00 PM; Peer Reviews due Monday by 11:00 PM.
